Title: Cards that i'm too stupid to use

Messages.Author: legbiter
Messages.Body:
Some recent threads have reminded me of an important principle of my
deck-design which rather shocked Nikki Sehmi when i explained it to
him at UK Gencon. i refer to the non-inclusion of cards which i am too
stupid to use. Foremost amongst these are Temptation, because i ALWAYS
forget to put the counters on when it is time to do so; and Direct
Intervention which kills me about as often as it saves me. My Master
Phase Bleed for 7 [on yourself] use of Millicent Smith has passed into
UK legend, but Form of Mist i think i just about understand still.
Mind Rape has always been too clever for me, and embarassingly so is
Renegade Garou [forgot to use his manouever in Uk Gencon]. Is anybody
else prepared to admit to being too DUMB to play with any particular
card? Maybe we could form a Vampire: The Eternal Simpleton society and
swap tips about those excruciatingly embarassing Doh! moments when you
realise that there are no independent vampires in your Free States
rant deck, or that Talbot's Chainsaw isn't a melee weapon and can hurt
the Werewolf Pack just fine.

Messages.Author: James Lewis
Messages.Body:
Have done a similar thing myself although in my case I minion tapped,
then called a Parity Shift before realising that no-one had more pool
than me. Think this is generally symptomatic of a fault in my play. I
tend to do one thing before thinking how its going to effect what elese
I'm planning to do on my turn. I really need to remind myself to stop
and think before actually doing things (see my previous comment about
forgetting to play master cards).


Messages.Author: James Lewis
Messages.Body:
Think the Bum's Rush thing is more a case of me putting cards in to do one thing (e.g. Bum's Rush
to get me into combat) and forgetting that cards also have other things on them (e.g. Bum's Rush has
a maneuver). I really ought to actually read cards before I play them. I'm fortunately not the only
one afflicted by this. I remember pointing out to Barney on one occasion that Legacy of Power puts
BOTH Vampires into torpor. Not that he didn't still go on to win the game

